Eight entire figures, equal 4x2 cells, generous transparent padding at least 12 percent each cell, NO overlap or clipping. True transparent background. No ground, shadows, motion lines, labels, numbers, text, props or backdrop. This is a smooth coherent animation strip, not eight unrelated illustrations.
